# sunplus-integrated-webcam-fhd

> Sunplus Integrated_Webcam_FHD — the field laptop's built-in FHD webcam, a UVC camera on USB

**Vendor:** Sunplus Innovation Technology  ·  **class:** [camera](camera-class.md)

Status: **untested** — catalogued from documented sources, not yet proven here.

**Not maintainer-verified**: nobody on this project has run this hardware yet. The two facts are recorded separately on purpose (D-027) — a correct recipe and a tested device are different claims.

## What it is

The laptop's built-in webcam, a Sunplus Innovation module wired to the machine's internal USB bus and driven by uvcvideo as /dev/videoN.

## What you can do with it

Park it so no program can open the camera, and wake it for a video call. See the `camera` class for what a park does and does not promise.

## Setup

Nothing to install. `hammunition hardware park camera` and `hammunition hardware wake camera`. Parking has not been run on this camera.

## Known problems

Parking is the kernel's view, not a hardware privacy switch. A program holding the camera open loses it on park as it would on an unplug.
